ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: After the 1980s, the state adjusted the layout of cotton production and put forward the guiding principle of “stabilizing the south, developing the north, and greatly developing Xinjiang.” Since the 1990s, Xinjiang’s cotton industry has developed rapidly. Xinjiang has become China’s largest cotton production base; what is its main locational factor?

Multiple cotton regions are marked within the outline of China; the northwest Xinjiang location has a cotton-region symbol and is marked as Ⅰ, North China has Ⅱ, and the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River have Ⅲ, indicating that the question focuses on the layout relationship between Xinjiang and other major cotton regions. Then reason: The question stem emphasizes that after the 1980s the state adjusted the cotton production layout and put forward the guiding principle of “stabilizing the south, developing the north, and greatly developing Xinjiang”; afterward, since the 1990s, Xinjiang’s cotton industry developed rapidly. Therefore, the main locational factor for Xinjiang becoming China’s largest cotton production base is policy support.

method.method_draft: 先看图：图中是中国棉花生产布局示意，西北部新疆位置标有棉区符号/编号，与华北、长江流域等棉区并列，说明题目关注的是新疆这一棉花基地。再读题干：国家在20世纪80年代后提出“南方稳定，北方发展，新疆大发展”的指导方针，随后20世纪90年代以来新疆棉花产业迅速发展。把“国家调整布局”“指导方针”“新疆大发展”对应到农业区位因素中的社会经济因素，可判断主导因素是国家政策扶持。
